differences_from_brief_followed_part: Brief: 'tracker 2 s predicted covariance V-hat'. Part: predicted mean and 2x2 covariance Sigma-hat_h at every check time h in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2} s. Drawn as 'm-hat_h, Sigma-hat_h at each check time h' (no numbers), symbol Sigma-hat as in the part.

Brief: 'enforced and relied constraint items'. Part IV-A: fitting uses every separating axis of every enforced pair at the reference pose; the relied axis is used only for scoring. Drawn as 'constraints the planner enforces, at the logged reference ego pose' and 'each separating object axis'.
Strata as in the brief (group x range x axis x course-change state); the part adds that thresholds are fitted separately per check time and for in-path and other tracks; drawn.
'5-fold cross-fitting' drawn as 'cross-fitted over log folds' to keep the figure free of numbers; the caption keeps it general too.
Deployed covariance identical to the brief and Proposition 5: Sigma-tilde = A (Sigma-hat_h + sigma_a^2 I) A, A diagonal along the box axes; alpha = max(c-hat, eps)/z added from Algorithm 1 line 12.
